allowCustomPersonalRoomURL.description: Allow hosts to change their Personal Room URLs.

entryAndExitTone.description:
Determines if a sound is made when someone enters or exits.
 * `NoTone` - No tone.
 * `Beep` - Beep.
 * `AnnounceName` - Announce name.

joinTeleconfNotPress1.description: Specifies whether or not joining teleconference without pressing 1 is checked by default.

telephonySupport.description:
Specifies the type of teleconference support for meetings.
 * `None` - None.
 * `WebexTeleconferencing` - Webex teleconferencing (Unabled when Webex Super Admin hasn't turned on call-in teleconferencing and call-back teleconferencing).
 * `Other` - Other Teleconferencing (Unabled when Webex Super Admin hasn't turned on other teleconferencing).

tollFree.description: Specifies whether toll-free call-in is available, it can't be specified when `telephonySupport` was not `WebexTeleconferencing`, and it can't be specified as `true` when Webex Super Admin hasn't turned on toll-free call-in teleconferencing.

VoIP.description: Denotes if VoIP protocols are being used, it can't be specified as `true` when Webex Super Admin hasn't turned on Voice Over IP functionality.

defaultSchedulerOptions.description: Default Scheduler Options on Webex Administration (These options are applied to the site as defaults, but individual users can change them).

emailReminders.description: Determines if email reminders are to be sent out.

scheduleMeetingOptions.description: Schedule Meeting Options on Webex Administration.

joinBeforeHost.description: Allow attendees or panelists to join before the host.

audioBeforeHost.description: Allows attendees or panelists to join the teleconference before the host, it can't be turned on when `joinBeforeHost` was `false`.

firstAttendeeAsPresenter.description: Allows first attendee or panelist as the presenter, it can't be turned on when `firstAttendeeAsPresenter` was `false`.

unlistAllMeetings.description: Specifies that all meetings must be unlisted.

requireLoginBeforeAccess.description: Determines if a user must login before getting site access.

requireStrongPassword.description: Determines if strict passwords are required for meetings.

mixedCase.description: Determines if a password requires mixed case.

minLength.description: Sets the minimum password length, maximum value limit of 12.

minNumeric.description: Sets the minimum number of numeric characters in the password, maximum value limit of 12.

minAlpha.description: Sets the minimum number of alphabetical characters in the password, maximum value limit of 12.

minSpecial.description: Sets the minimum number of special characters in the password, maximum value limit of 12.

disallowDynamicWebText.description: Do not allow dynamic web page text for meeting passwords (like site name, host's name, username, meeting topic).

disallowList.description: Specifies if passwords from the `disallowValues` list are to be allowed.

disallowValues.description: Sets password values that are not allowed, and cannot type repeated items in it.

passwordCriteria.description: Criteria of a strong password, which cannot be specified when `requireStrongPassword` was `false`.
